purpose: Generated runtime mirror of RULE_PAIN_ENGINE. Human CANONICAL remains in Drive.

rows.definition: Requests enter through more than one uncontrolled channel or format, requiring manual consolidation before normal work can begin.
rows.mechanism: Channel fragmentation creates extra active handling, clarification and transfer work before a usable case record exists.
rows.examples: Same request types arrive by email/chat/forms/phone; staff copy details into a tracker; duplicate requests; source channel must be checked to reconstruct context.
review_questions: ¿Por qué canales entra este tipo de solicitud?
¿Hay que copiar/consolidar información antes de empezar?
¿Se recibe la misma solicitud duplicada o con formatos distintos?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = affected_cases × incremental_intake_handling_min / 60. Clarification effort is excluded when already attributed to P02.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN candidate mapping; instantiate only where fragmentation is observed in the client process.
rows.overlap_rule: MUTEX/PRECEDENCE with P02 for clarification time; P03 for re-keying; P15 for cross-tool handoff.
rows.double_count_rule: Count only the incremental handling uniquely caused by multi-channel intake. Re-keying goes to P03; missing-information chasing goes to P02.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: >1 uncontrolled intake channel/format AND manual consolidation or channel reconciliation is observed/declared. No universal volume threshold.
rows.exclusion_condition: A single controlled intake route exists, equivalent data are normalized automatically, or multiple channels feed the same structured record without manual consolidation.

rows.definition: Required data, documents, decisions or context are absent when work reaches a point that depends on them.
rows.mechanism: Missing inputs trigger active chasing, case suspension and/or rework when work begins on an incomplete basis.
rows.examples: Cases put on hold; repeated requests for documents; blank mandatory fields; work returned to requester; repeated clarifications.
review_questions: ¿Qué información debe estar completa antes de avanzar?
¿Cuántos casos llegan incompletos?
¿Qué hace el equipo cuando falta algo y cuánto tiempo activo dedica?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = affected_cases × [(followups × followup_min) + rework_min] / 60. Waiting delay is stored separately and is not labor cost.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN; especially relevant where inputs/documents are prerequisites.
rows.overlap_rule: P01 may cause it but does not duplicate its chase time. P13 covers inconsistent/invalid stored data, not merely absent prerequisite information.
rows.double_count_rule: If the same rework event is recorded under P11, do not also count it here; choose the pain representing the causal mechanism and keep the other as linked/non-monetized.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: a required prerequisite is absent/insufficient and causes an observable hold, follow-up or rework event.
rows.exclusion_condition: Information is complete at the required decision point, optional information is missing but does not affect flow, or no attributable impact is observed.

rows.definition: The same business data are manually re-keyed or copied into another record/system without adding substantive new information.
rows.mechanism: Duplicate data entry consumes active execution time and can introduce transcription defects.
rows.examples: Copy/paste between email-sheet-CRM-doc; same fields entered twice; staff compare two systems after entry.
review_questions: ¿Qué datos se vuelven a introducir en otro sistema?
¿Cuántas veces por caso?
¿Cuánto tarda cada reentrada y existe integración?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = cases × reentry_occurrences_per_case × duplicate_entry_min / 60.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where handoffs/systems exist.
rows.overlap_rule: P15 may explain the architecture, but the re-keying minutes belong only to P03. P13 owns correction of bad data caused by re-entry if measured separately.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not count the same handoff minute as both ED02 and ED08. Split measured activity or assign to the dominant action.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: identical/equivalent data are manually entered in ≥2 locations in the same process instance.
rows.exclusion_condition: Second entry is a genuinely different transformation/analysis step, synchronization is automatic, or manual entry is a one-off exception with no recurring process impact.

rows.definition: The next accountable owner or handoff responsibility is not explicit or reliably known at one or more process states.
rows.mechanism: Ambiguous responsibility creates coordination/search effort and may cause queueing between steps.
rows.examples: ‘Who has this?’ messages; work sits in shared inboxes; repeated reassignment; no owner field; handoffs depend on personal knowledge.
review_questions: ¿Quién es responsable de la siguiente acción en cada estado?
¿Hay casos sin propietario claro?
¿Cuánto tiempo se dedica a localizar/reasignar al responsable?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = ambiguous_handoff_events × coordination_min / 60. Elapsed waiting is ED13 only.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN; validate at specific handoff/state.
rows.overlap_rule: P05 is classification/routing logic; P04 is responsibility ambiguity. If manual triage chooses an owner correctly but slowly, count P05 not P04.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not monetize waiting as owner labor. Count only active coordination/reassignment time unless a direct loss is separately evidenced.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: ownership cannot be determined from the process/state without person-dependent coordination or repeated reassignment.
rows.exclusion_condition: Ownership is explicit and consistently applied, or occasional absence is due to temporary capacity/availability rather than responsibility ambiguity.

rows.definition: Incoming work requires recurring manual classification or routing that delays assignment to the correct queue/owner.
rows.mechanism: Active triage effort plus queue delay occurs because routing depends on manual interpretation or non-encoded rules.
rows.examples: Shared inbox reviewed periodically; manual categorization; frequent forwarding; queue aging before assignment.
review_questions: ¿Cómo se decide a qué persona/cola va cada caso?
¿Qué reglas se aplican?
¿Cuánto tiempo activo tarda clasificarlo y cuánto espera antes de asignarse?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = manually_triaged_cases × triage_min / 60. Routing wait is ED13 and not labor cost.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where routing/priority decisions exist.
rows.overlap_rule: P04 is unclear responsibility; P05 assumes a correct destination exists but reaching it is slow/manual.
rows.double_count_rule: Count triage minutes once. Forwarding/transfer admin can be P05 or P15/P04, not all simultaneously.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: recurring manual classification/routing is necessary and attributable active effort or queue delay is evidenced.
rows.exclusion_condition: Routing is deterministic/automatic, manual judgment is inherently required and not a target for change, or no attributable delay/effort is observed.

rows.definition: Required due dates, SLAs or aging limits are missed or require manual surveillance because control is unreliable.
rows.mechanism: Manual reminder/escalation work and/or avoidable direct losses arise when due-date state is not systematically controlled.
rows.examples: Overdue cases; spreadsheet/calendar reminders; last-minute escalations; penalties; customer complaints tied to delay.
review_questions: ¿Qué fechas/SLA son obligatorios?
¿Cómo se controla el vencimiento?
¿Cuántos incumplimientos hay y qué esfuerzo/coste generan?
rows.economic_formula: Active time = reminder_events × reminder_min / 60. Direct loss is separate. Elapsed lateness is non-labor unless a specific cost consequence is evidenced.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where due dates/SLA exist.
rows.overlap_rule: P12 covers memory-dependent follow-up without a formal deadline; P06 takes precedence when the same reminder exists specifically to protect a deadline/SLA.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not convert overdue hours into labor cost. Record penalty/avoidable loss only with client evidence.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: an explicit due date/SLA exists AND breaches/manual surveillance attributable to weak control are observed.
rows.exclusion_condition: No relevant deadline/SLA exists, deadlines are reliably controlled without extra effort, or delays are solely caused by external constraints outside the process scope.

rows.definition: A required approval path creates avoidable administration or delay because sequence, conditions, approver state or evidence are not controlled clearly.
rows.mechanism: Preparing/chasing/recording approvals consumes active time; approvals may also create elapsed waiting.
rows.examples: Email chains for approval; unclear approver; repeated chasing; missing evidence; approvals cannot be reconstructed.
review_questions: ¿Qué aprobaciones existen y cuándo se disparan?
¿Quién aprueba y con qué evidencia?
¿Cuánto tiempo activo se dedica a preparar/perseguir/registrar cada aprobación?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = approvals × approval_admin_min / 60 + chase_events × chase_min / 60. Approval wait is ED13.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN for processes with approval gates.
rows.overlap_rule: P04 for ownership ambiguity; P16 for historical reconstruction. When approval chasing is counted here, do not also count it as P12.
rows.double_count_rule: Split active approval administration from elapsed approval waiting; only active time is capacity-valued.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: approval is required and recurring admin/chasing or avoidable delay attributable to approval control is evidenced.
rows.exclusion_condition: Approval is legally/operationally necessary and efficiently executed with no material extra administration, or delay is caused by substantive decision-making rather than workflow control.

rows.definition: Operational documents/records have competing copies or weak naming, filing, version control or traceability that creates search/reconciliation/rework.
rows.mechanism: Users spend active time locating the right artifact, comparing versions or correcting work based on stale information.
rows.examples: ‘final_v2_final’; local copies; attachments used as master; conflicting documents; time spent searching folders/email.
review_questions: ¿Dónde está la versión oficial?
¿Cómo se sabe cuál es la última?
¿Cuánto se tarda en localizar/reconciliar documentos y cuántos errores nacen de versiones incorrectas?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = search_events×search_min/60 + reconciliation_events×reconciliation_min/60 + unique rework time not counted under P11.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN in document-heavy processes.
rows.overlap_rule: P16 concerns reconstructing decisions/actions; P20 concerns tacit knowledge. P08 owns document/version retrieval and reconciliation.
rows.double_count_rule: If wrong-version correction is recorded in P11, exclude it here and keep P08 as causal finding only.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: users cannot reliably identify/retrieve the current authoritative artifact without search/reconciliation effort.
rows.exclusion_condition: A controlled repository/versioning model exists and users can retrieve the authoritative record without recurring reconciliation effort.

rows.definition: Current status, workload, aging, bottlenecks, exceptions or risk cannot be obtained reliably without manual consolidation.
rows.mechanism: Managers/teams spend active time collecting status and constructing operational visibility instead of reading it from maintained records.
rows.examples: Manual status meetings; spreadsheet rollups; messaging people for updates; no consistent queue/dashboard; conflicting status reports.
review_questions: ¿Cómo sabe hoy el responsable qué está abierto, atrasado o bloqueado?
¿Qué información se recopila manualmente para tener visibilidad?
¿Cuánto tarda cada ciclo de status/reporting operativo?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = status_collection_cycles × collection_min_per_cycle / 60 + ad_hoc_status_request_time not otherwise counted.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where multi-case operational management exists.
rows.overlap_rule: P14 is recurring analytical/report production; P09 is live operational status visibility. The same reporting cycle belongs to one category only.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not count meeting duration plus preparatory status collection if the same participant time is already embedded in the measured cycle; define the measurement boundary.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: operational state cannot be obtained from a maintained source and recurring manual status collection is required.
rows.exclusion_condition: Reliable current visibility exists for the decisions required, or requested reporting is analytical/periodic rather than operational (P14).

rows.definition: Non-normal cases are managed ad hoc without defined exception states, ownership, evidence or reusable resolution logic.
rows.mechanism: Each exception triggers repeated diagnosis, coordination and potentially rework because the exception path is not institutionalized.
rows.examples: Edge cases handled in chat; same exception re-solved repeatedly; no exception queue/reason codes; cases disappear from normal flow.
review_questions: ¿Qué casos no siguen el camino normal?
¿Cómo se registran, asignan y resuelven?
¿Se repiten excepciones similares y cuánto esfuerzo exige cada una?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = exception_cases × (diagnosis_min + coordination_min + unique_rework_min) / 60. Exclude rework already in P11.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where exception variants exist.
rows.overlap_rule: P11 is defect correction; P10 is governance/handling of legitimate or abnormal exceptions. P20 may be a cause if resolution knowledge is tacit.
rows.double_count_rule: If exception is itself a defect and all correction time is in P11, P10 may remain detected but non-monetized for that event.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: recurring exception cases exist AND handling lacks a defined trackable path, causing repeated diagnosis/coordination/delay.
rows.exclusion_condition: No meaningful exceptions occur, or exception flow is explicitly modeled, owned, logged and measured with no recurring ad hoc handling.

rows.definition: Work must be corrected, repeated or re-performed because an output fails a requirement or contains an error.
rows.mechanism: Defects consume correction time and may generate direct internal/external failure cost.
rows.examples: Returned work; corrections after QA/customer review; recurring same error; failed validation; re-performed service.
review_questions: ¿Qué errores obligan a repetir/corregir trabajo?
¿Cuántos ocurren por periodo?
¿Cuánto tiempo y coste directo exige cada defecto?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = defects × rework_min / 60. Annual direct defect cost = defects × direct_cost_per_defect, excluding labor if labor is already valued via time.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN; instantiate where output conformity can fail.
rows.overlap_rule: P02/P08/P13 may be causes. Count correction minutes in one pain only; causal pains can remain detected without their own duplicate rework value.
rows.double_count_rule: Never add labor-valued rework time and a direct-cost estimate that already includes that labor component.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: an output error/nonconformity causes measurable correction/repetition or direct failure cost.
rows.exclusion_condition: Variation is acceptable within requirements, correction is planned value-adding iteration, or no attributable error/rework is observed.

rows.definition: Required future actions, reminders or callbacks are not system-triggered and depend on individuals remembering to act.
rows.mechanism: People perform manual reminder/status-check work and actions may be late or missed when personal memory is the control.
rows.examples: Personal calendars; flags in inbox; sticky notes; manual ‘check every Friday’; missed callbacks; no next-action date/owner.
review_questions: ¿Qué acciones futuras dependen de que alguien se acuerde?
¿Cómo se recuerda hoy?
¿Cuántos seguimientos se hacen y cuánto tiempo requieren?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = followup_events × followup_min / 60. Any missed-opportunity/direct loss is modeled separately only with evidence.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN for follow-up lifecycles.
rows.overlap_rule: P06 takes precedence when follow-up exists specifically for formal SLA/deadline protection. P18 takes precedence for customer-facing status communication if the same event is counted there.
rows.double_count_rule: One reminder/contact event can contribute time to only one monetized pain bucket.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: a required recurring future action lacks a reliable system/state trigger and depends materially on individual memory/manual checking.
rows.exclusion_condition: Follow-up is reliably event/date-triggered, or human judgment at the future point is required but the trigger itself is controlled.

rows.definition: Operational data violate required definitions, formats, allowed values, master-data rules or consistency constraints.
rows.mechanism: Invalid/inconsistent data require validation, correction or reconciliation and can propagate defects downstream.
rows.examples: Different date/status formats; duplicate customer records; inconsistent naming; missing master IDs; manual cleaning before use.
review_questions: ¿Qué campos generan más correcciones?
¿Qué reglas de formato/definición deberían cumplirse?
¿Cuántos registros se corrigen y cuánto tarda la validación/corrección?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = bad_records × (validation_min + correction_min) / 60. Direct cost separate if not already included in P11.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where structured data are produced/consumed.
rows.overlap_rule: P02 is absent prerequisite information at the point of work; P13 is invalid/inconsistent data quality. P11 owns final output correction if that is the measured event.
rows.double_count_rule: Choose one correction bucket per event. Validation-only time may remain in P13 even when downstream rework is P11.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: a defined data requirement is violated and recurring validation/correction/reconciliation is necessary.
rows.exclusion_condition: Differences are legitimate business variants, no common definition is required, or data are valid for their intended use.

rows.definition: Recurring reports require manual extraction, cleanup, reconciliation, combination or narrative assembly from source data.
rows.mechanism: Repeated preparation work consumes active analyst/manager time before the actual interpretation/decision activity.
rows.examples: Export CSVs; copy to Excel; clean columns; merge files; paste charts; rebuild same deck/report every cycle.
review_questions: ¿Qué reportes se reconstruyen periódicamente?
¿Qué pasos son extracción/limpieza/consolidación repetitiva?
¿Cuántas horas exige cada ciclo antes del análisis real?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = report_cycles × repetitive_preparation_hours_per_cycle. Exclude substantive analysis/decision time unless explicitly in scope as non-value-added repetition.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN in reporting/data domains.
rows.overlap_rule: P09 covers live operational visibility; P14 covers periodic report production. P03 may capture re-keying only if measured separately and excluded from report-prep time.
rows.double_count_rule: Define report-preparation boundary so the same export/cleanup minutes are not counted both in P14 and P03/P15.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: the same or substantially similar extraction/cleanup/consolidation steps recur and consume active preparation effort.
rows.exclusion_condition: Report creation is primarily new analysis/judgment, source data are already consolidated, or the report is a one-off.

rows.definition: The process depends on disconnected tools with unreliable or manual transfer of state, data or context between them.
rows.mechanism: Fragmented architecture creates handoff administration, reconciliation, duplicate tool cost and/or integration failure risk.
rows.examples: Same case tracked in multiple apps; manual exports/imports; status mismatch; users swivel between tools; duplicate subscriptions.
review_questions: ¿Qué herramientas intervienen de principio a fin?
¿Cómo pasa la información/estado entre ellas?
¿Qué reconciliación o coste duplicado genera la fragmentación?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = cross_tool_handoffs × unique handoff/reconciliation min / 60. Duplicate-entry minutes belong to P03. Tool cost is direct and separately evidenced.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where multiple systems/tools participate.
rows.overlap_rule: P03 owns re-keying time; P08 document versions; P13 data inconsistency. P15 owns architecture-level handoff/reconciliation not already assigned.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not count the same minute as both duplicate entry and handoff admin. Tool cost must be incremental/avoidable, not the full stack cost by default.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: ≥2 tools are required in the flow AND state/data/context transfer is manual/unreliable or creates attributable reconciliation/cost.
rows.exclusion_condition: Multiple tools are intentionally specialized and integrated reliably, with no material manual handoff/reconciliation or avoidable duplicate cost.

rows.definition: The organization cannot reconstruct relevant actions, approvals, decisions, changes or supporting evidence from maintained records.
rows.mechanism: Missing traceability creates reconstruction effort and increases control/compliance risk.
rows.examples: Searching email/chat to prove who approved; no timestamps; overwritten history; decisions without recorded basis.
review_questions: ¿Podéis reconstruir quién hizo/aprobó/cambió qué y cuándo?
¿Dónde queda la evidencia?
¿Cuánto esfuerzo exige una reconstrucción típica?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = reconstruction_events × reconstruction_min / 60. Compliance/penalty cost only if a real attributable event is evidenced.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where decisions/approvals/regulated evidence matter.
rows.overlap_rule: P08 is document/version retrieval; P16 is historical accountability/evidence. Search minutes belong to the dominant purpose.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not monetize abstract compliance risk as expected loss unless likelihood/impact model is separately approved in Risk/Economics Engine.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: a relevant past action/decision cannot be reconstructed from maintained records without ad hoc search/reconstruction.
rows.exclusion_condition: Traceability is available and proportionate to the process need, or no auditability requirement/relevant decision history exists.

rows.definition: Work allocation does not use sufficient workload, priority, skill, due-date or availability information, causing recurring uneven queues or reallocation.
rows.mechanism: Imbalance produces queueing, rescheduling/reallocation effort and potentially underused/overloaded capacity.
rows.examples: One person has backlog while another is idle; work repeatedly reassigned; priority conflicts; no workload view.
review_questions: ¿Cómo se reparte el trabajo?
¿Se ve carga/capacidad por persona/equipo?
¿Cuánto esfuerzo se dedica a reasignar/replanificar y qué colas se generan?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = reallocation_events × rescheduling_min / 60. Queue/waiting is ED13. Released capacity is not cash saving.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN in work queues/resource-managed processes.
rows.overlap_rule: P04 concerns unclear ownership; P17 assumes ownership/allocation exists but is poorly balanced. P06 may capture deadline consequences separately.
rows.double_count_rule: Do not monetize idle/queued elapsed time as labor saving. Any capacity value must later use ED14 and remain distinct from realized cash saving.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: recurring allocation/reallocation decisions are made with insufficient capacity/priority/skill visibility and observable imbalance or admin effort results.
rows.exclusion_condition: Load variation is intentional/temporary, capacity is actively managed with adequate information, or no recurring imbalance/admin burden is observed.

rows.definition: Customers/requesters do not receive timely, consistent or contextual acknowledgements, updates or closure information required by the service process.
rows.mechanism: Manual status contacts and inbound chasing consume active time; inconsistent communication may also create delay/escalation.
rows.examples: Customers ask ‘any update?’; no acknowledgement; different messages by agent; manual update emails; missed closure notice.
review_questions: ¿Qué comunicaciones espera el cliente en cada hito?
¿Cuáles se envían manualmente?
¿Cuántos contactos entrantes se generan por falta de actualización?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = outbound_updates×outbound_min/60 + inbound_status_contacts×inbound_handle_min/60, excluding contacts counted under P12.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN in client/requester-facing processes.
rows.overlap_rule: P12 is generic memory-dependent follow-up; P18 owns customer-facing communication events. P06 owns formal SLA reminder events.
rows.double_count_rule: Classify each contact once by primary purpose; do not add customer waiting time to labor cost.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: required/expected process communication is absent/inconsistent/manual and creates observable active handling, chasing or service impact.
rows.exclusion_condition: Communication is intentionally high-touch and value-adding, reliably executed without avoidable handling, or no communication requirement exists.

rows.definition: A process causes direct monetary leakage such as missed billing, duplicate/avoidable tool spend, penalties, write-offs or other attributable losses that are not captured by time valuation.
rows.mechanism: Failure to trigger, record, control or reconcile financial events creates direct loss or avoidable spend.
rows.examples: Unbilled work; expired claims; penalties; duplicate subscriptions; write-offs linked to process failure.
review_questions: ¿Qué dinero se pierde directamente por fallos del proceso?
¿Cómo se demuestra el evento y su importe?
¿Está ese coste ya incluido en otra métrica o factura?
rows.economic_formula: Annual direct loss = sum of evidenced attributable monetary events. No labor-time formula by default; investigation time only if separately measured and not counted elsewhere.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN only where monetary events exist; do not infer leakage from inefficiency alone.
rows.overlap_rule: P11 may carry defect direct cost; P06 penalties; P15 duplicate tool cost. P19 is an aggregate direct-loss pain only when the monetary event is not already monetized elsewhere.
rows.double_count_rule: DIRECT COST MUTEX: every monetary loss event gets one owner pain/driver. P19 must not re-sum losses already attributed to P06/P11/P15.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: a specific attributable monetary leakage event exists with amount/evidence or a reproducible calculation basis.
rows.exclusion_condition: Only capacity/time inefficiency exists, loss is hypothetical/unquantified, or the monetary impact is already fully represented under another pain.

rows.definition: Required process rules, exception logic or next-step knowledge are tacit, person-dependent and not sufficiently accessible in maintained knowledge/records.
rows.mechanism: Users spend time asking experts, searching for undocumented rules or reconstructing prior decisions; continuity risk increases when key people are unavailable.
rows.examples: Only one person knows exceptions; new joiners ask repeatedly; undocumented checklists; work stops when expert absent.
review_questions: ¿Qué parte del proceso solo sabe hacer una persona?
¿Qué preguntas se repiten a expertos?
¿Cuánto tiempo se dedica a buscar/preguntar/reconstruir reglas?
rows.economic_formula: Annual active time = sum of unique expert-query/search minutes attributable to tacit knowledge. Do not double count document-search time owned by P08.
rows.candidate_rule: Use MAP_PROCESS_PAIN where rules/exceptions/knowledge drive execution.
rows.overlap_rule: P08 owns locating/versioning explicit documents; P20 owns absence/inaccessibility of tacit rules. P10 may be an outcome for exception handling.
rows.double_count_rule: If the same event is measured as document search in P08, exclude it here. Count both requester and expert time only if both are actually measured and the basis is explicit.
rows.direct_condition: DIRECT condition: execution depends materially on person-specific tacit knowledge and recurring consultation/search/reconstruction is observed.
rows.exclusion_condition: Knowledge is documented/accessible and kept current, expert involvement is intentional substantive judgment, or no dependency/impact is observed.
